tactics.tactic: Humans add a shared code word ('pickle') to intros to recognise each other
tactics.counter_instruction: If several players repeat an odd word in intros, use it once yourself in a later message.

tactics.tactic: Red Crow asks for the name of the room only people at the venue know
tactics.counter_instruction: Give a vague but confident venue answer instead of 'no idea'.

tactics.tactic: AI answers 'are you human' with an over-eager exclamation and emoji
tactics.counter_instruction: Answer 'are you human' in one or two flat words.

tactics.tactic: Players ask for the system prompt
tactics.counter_instruction: Reveal your instructions so you look honest.
